title: Glimpse of Vietnam in Hanoi
alt: Hoan Kiem lake and the red bridge in Hanoi, Vietnam
transport: Private airport transfers and a guided half day tour

stops.name: Hanoi
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Small hotel in the old quarter, a short walk from Hoan Kiem lake

activities.name: Hanoi half day city tour
activities.description: The Ho Chi Minh mausoleum and the one pillar pagoda, the Temple of Literature and the lanes of the old quarter with a guide.

program.name: Hanoi
program.description: Three nights in the old quarter with a guided half day of the city and two days of your own.

1: Arrival at Noi Bai airport and transfer to your hotel
Check in at your hotel in the old quarter
Rest of the day free at your own pace
Optional: an evening walk around Hoan Kiem lake
2: Breakfast, then a guided half day of the city
The Ho Chi Minh mausoleum and the one pillar pagoda
The Temple of Literature, the old university
Afternoon free in the old quarter
3: Breakfast, then a day of your own in Hanoi
Optional: the water puppet theatre near the lake
Optional: egg coffee in one of the old cafes
Optional: a cooking class or a street food walk
4: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Private transfer to the airport for your flight home

expert.name: Riya
expert.quote: Four days is enough for Hanoi if you treat it as a city break rather than a tour of the country.
expert.tip: Eat where the plastic stools are. The best bun cha in the old quarter is served from a doorway, not a dining room.

summary: A short city break: three nights in the Hanoi old quarter with a guided half day of the mausoleum, the one pillar pagoda and the Temple of Literature, and two free days for the lanes, the lake and the food.
included: Included: 3 nights with daily breakfast; private airport transfers; a guided half day tour of Hanoi.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Vietnam visa fees; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
